recipes.name: Fried Rice
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen green peas, thawed

steps.text: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil. Add rice and stir. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, season eggs with salt and pepper.

Heat 1 teaspoon oil in small frying pan. Pour in eggs. Coat the bottom of the pan evenly with eggs; cook for about 3 minutes. Flip eggs, cook 1 minute more, and transfer them to a cool surface. Let cool, then cut into thin slices. Set aside.
Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly browned. Drain, crumble, and set aside.

Spoon remaining 2 teaspoons oil into the skillet with the bacon fat. Stir in cooked rice; break up any clumps and toss to coat with oil. Stir in bacon, soy sauce, peas, eggs, and green onions. Stir and cook until heated through, approximately 3 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Fried Rice
raw_recipe.description: Fried rice is a favorite. In this easy recipe, white rice is tossed with eggs, bacon, soy sauce, green peas, and green onions.

review.reviewBody: I liked this recipe, but made a few changes. I cooked the rice in advance and refrigerated it for a few hours before starting to prepare the fried rice. Instead of cooking the egg in advance, I just added the beaten uncooked eggs (just 2 eggs)to the rice mixture at the end, stir-frying it until the egg was completely cooked. You can tell when the egg is cooked because it isn't shiny anymore. A Chinese friend taught me how to do this.

Excellent base recipe, but here is how to make it DELICIOUS!!! So I followed the original recipe for the most part.But did make these few awesome changes IMO! heehee. I decided to not use the bacon( just trying to cut back on the fat protein for the day) I cooked my white rice, (rice bowl from ALDI) and also used the JUMBO shrimp from ALDI. while the rice cooked I fried up the egg, set it aside then used sesame oil about (3 teaspoons) and tossed in the onion, and a bag of steam-fresh "California style " Protein Blends grains,lentils,peas, broccoli and edamame. Then tossed in the 1/2 bag of thawed Jumbo shrimp and let cook until it kind of thickened. Now that teh rice is done, add rice and toss together. Then here is where it went from Good to DELICIOUS! I thought it needed something more, once I added the soy sauce. So I decided to make a little mixture- 2 tablespoons of honey and 1-2 of soy sauce and whisk it together taste it! ( it depends on your own idea of "perfect" as to the ratio) to make a sweet & sour sauce. I pored that over all the ingredients and stirred it together - DELICIOUS!! Bon Appetit ya'll :)

Love, Love LOVE this! My husband thought it was the best ever and he is one fussy guy! I didn’t have the green onions so I sautéed regular chopped onions in the oil before adding the rice etc and we really liked it this way. Will definitely be making again.

I didn't use bacon, but did use some leftover bacon grease instead of oil, that was yummy! I made a well in the center of the fried rice mixture near the end & cooked the eggs that way, then reincorporated them back into the fried rice. I sautéed green onions plus some yellow onions for the very first step, then added cold, leftover rice next. I saved some fresh green onions to sprinkle on top. Great recipe that can be modified easily to your own personal tastes!

I substituted the bacon for tofu marinated in soy sauce, and then cooked the egg together with the veggie mixture. Added rice once the egg was about halfway done cooking. Oh and I also added shredded carrots

This dish came out so good that leftovers were non existent. There is a technical mistake in the recipe and the rice should be cooked in advanced and chilled so it's not mushy. A few changes were made such as leaving the peas out since we don't like peas and adding fresh chopped garlic, brown onion, carrot, and Roma tomato. I cooked the garlic, carrot and brown onion in the soy sauce and oils before adding the rice and tomato. 
I also cooked the eggs at the very end by putting the raw eggs with the rice and mixed until the dish was no longer shiny.

I made as directed, except I cooked the rice ahead of time and use cold rice. I also added the eggs at the end, moved the rice to one half of the skillet and the other half I scrambled the eggs. When the eggs were done I mixed together. It just needed something flavor-wise so I added ground ginger that I had and that made it much better. It's a great recipe.

I used chicken instead of bacon and added extra carrots, peas and pea pods. Chilling the rice beforehand and using a teaspoon of rice vinegar, sesame oil and veg. Oil to sauté is a game changer. This is the first time I tried this recipe and my husband said it was restaurant quality. Score one for mom!

In all fairness, I didn't make this recipe as stated. I hate it when people change the recipe all up then rate it on one end of the scale or the other. That being said, this was a great reference recipe and I'm so thankful I found it :) To start, I thought I had rice in the pantry but that was a big ol fail... so the only rice I had was a Knorr Chicken and Broccoli rice packet, so I thought what the heck. I cooked that first then let it cool down/dry out while I sauteed my veggies. I did onion, carrot, water chestnuts, and peas... then crumbled bacon, then added 3 eggs to it and scrambled them instead of how the directions state, added the rice, then the rest of the ingredients and it turned out really really well. The flavors melded together great and it was perfect under the baked chicken teriyaki recipe on here. I will definitely make this again, and might even follow the recipe :) I was really after a white rice base, but need to pay more attention to my pantry supplies first I guess... Thanks!

i love this recipe! I am vegetarian and my husband is Celiac so going out for Chinese food is difficult. i naturally skip the bacon and use gluten free soya sauce. i prefer this method of cooking the egg separately from the rice so you get nice chunks. i use frozen mixed vegetables instead of just peas. tastes just like takeout but i know what's in it.

The only reason I did not give it five stars, I made suggested changes that other reviewers recommended. 
1. Add the eggs (only two) toward the end, mixing till they were no longer clear.
2. I substituted Jasmine rice for the white. AWESOME! 
My husband's request, make the bacon pieces larger.
Easy recipe I’ve made before. I changed the way I made the rice 🍚 and wanted to try the fried rice recipe again!😋😋

Best fried rice I've ever had and my daughter, who doesn't like anything, loves it. However, if you're not going to follow the recipe and then complain because it's not great, don't leave a bad review. This needs to be fried in the bacon grease with the bacon added, or yes, it will be as bland as one would expect. Fried rice is usually best when starting with cold rice, but I always cook the rice at the same time and fry it right up, and the whole family loves it. Of course, I love bacon, so... we've also made this adding some chicken (along with the bacon), and that's good too.
Love this recipe.
Made this for my family tonight. It was good but needed more than 1/8 cup of soy sauce. Next time I will add a lot more.
Loved it. We added ham instead of bacon for a less fatty dish. We also added 1/2 teaspoon of curry powder for zing! We think we'll add pineapple next for a little sweet.
Easy to make and delicious as a side or on its own. My whole family thought it was great!
Added Bean Sprouts!
